content.tex: B MODELLING RANGES (20 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this part.
This task looks at the horizontal distance a ball, fired from a toy cannon on horizontal ground, travels before it hits the ground.
The horizontal distance that the ball travels is called the range. The angle the barrel of the toy cannon makes with horizontal ground is called the angle of elevation.
The range depends on the angle of elevation.
This diagram shows the path of a ball and its range for three different angles of elevation.
